moments.title: Commonwealth Games Glasgow concludes
moments.blurb: The 2026 Commonwealth Games in Glasgow wraps up today after 11 days of sporting action across 20 disciplines, featuring over 3,000 athletes from 74 nations and territories.

angles.name: Farewell Glasgow
angles.copy: It's been an incredible run! The Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games officially conclude today. What was your favourite moment?

angles.name: Sporting Legacy
angles.copy: From the opening ceremony to the final medal, the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow showcased elite talent. What a legacy for Scotland!

moments.title: Scottish Premiership continues
moments.blurb: The Scottish Premiership season kicks off its first full weekend with matches today including St Johnstone v Kilmarnock and Hibernian v Motherwell, followed by Celtic v Dundee tomorrow.

angles.name: Sunday Kick-off
angles.copy: Scottish Premiership action continues today! St Johnstone face Kilmarnock and Hibernian take on Motherwell. Who are you backing?

angles.name: Celtic in action
angles.copy: Tomorrow night, reigning champions Celtic begin their title defence against Dundee at Celtic Park. Get ready for some Monday night football!

moments.title: National Bank Open Tennis underway
moments.blurb: The National Bank Open, also known as the Canadian Open, is in full swing from August 1-13, with ATP Masters 1000 men's action in Montreal and WTA 1000 women's action in Toronto.

angles.name: North American Hard Courts
angles.copy: The road to the US Open continues! The National Bank Open is serving up top-tier tennis from Montreal and Toronto this week.

angles.name: Who to watch
angles.copy: Big names are battling it out in Canada at the National Bank Open. Who are you hoping to see lift the trophy?

moments.title: Scottish Summer Bank Holiday
moments.blurb: Scotland enjoys its Summer Bank Holiday tomorrow, August 3rd, offering a long weekend for many across the nation.

angles.name: Long Weekend Alert
angles.copy: Happy Bank Holiday Eve, Scotland! Hope you've got some great plans for your long weekend off tomorrow!

angles.name: Sunshine hopes
angles.copy: Fingers crossed for some sunshine for Scotland's Summer Bank Holiday tomorrow! How are you spending your extra day?

moments.title: Edinburgh Fringe Festival in full swing
moments.blurb: The world's largest arts festival, the Edinburgh Fringe, is captivating audiences with thousands of shows across comedy, theatre, music, and more until August 25.

angles.name: Fringe Frenzy
angles.copy: Edinburgh is buzzing! The Fringe Festival is delivering an incredible array of performances, from stand-up to experimental theatre. What's on your must-see list?

angles.name: Festival City
angles.copy: Immerse yourself in the magic of the Edinburgh Fringe! So much to see and do in Scotland's capital right now.

moments.title: Palace Bowl Presents concert series
moments.blurb: The Palace Bowl Presents concert series in London continues through August 16, featuring legendary acts like Tom Jones, Gary Numan, Bastille, Lenny Kravitz, and Jimmy Eat World.

angles.name: Live in London
angles.copy: London's Crystal Palace Bowl is hosting some massive names this August! Tom Jones, Gary Numan, Bastille, and more are still to come. Who are you hoping to catch?

angles.name: Summer Sounds
angles.copy: From rock legends to indie favourites, the Palace Bowl Presents series has something for everyone. Get down to Crystal Palace for some unforgettable summer gigs!

moments.title: Boardmasters Festival approaches
moments.blurb: Boardmasters Festival, a surf and music festival, takes place in Newquay, Cornwall from August 7-9, bringing a blend of music and beach culture to the Cornish coast.

angles.name: Cornwall Calling
angles.copy: Boardmasters is just days away! Get ready for three days of surf, music, and good vibes on the beautiful Cornish coast.

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Planning your trip to Boardmasters? The countdown is ON for one of the UK's most unique festivals in Newquay!

moments.title: Houghton and Bloodstock Festivals
moments.blurb: Two major UK festivals, Houghton (Norfolk, electronic music) and Bloodstock Open Air (Derbyshire, heavy metal), are set to run from August 6-9.

angles.name: Electronic vs Metal
angles.copy: Different vibes, same weekend! Houghton Festival brings the best in electronic music to Norfolk, while Bloodstock delivers heavy metal in Derbyshire. Which one are you at?

angles.name: Festival Choices
angles.copy: From dance anthems to headbanging riffs, there's a festival for every taste this weekend. Get ready for Houghton or Bloodstock!

moments.title: Happy 65th to Apollonia Kotero
moments.blurb: Apollonia Kotero, American singer, actress, and Prince's protégé as lead singer of Apollonia 6, turns 65 today.

angles.name: Purple Rain Star
angles.copy: Celebrating Apollonia Kotero's 65th birthday today! Best known for her role in Prince's 'Purple Rain' and fronting Apollonia 6. What's your favourite Apollonia track?

angles.name: 80s Icon
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the iconic Apollonia! Her contributions to 80s pop and film are legendary.

moments.title: Happy 68th to Ian Broudie
moments.blurb: Ian Broudie, English musician, songwriter, and producer, best known as the frontman of The Lightning Seeds, turns 68 on August 4th.

angles.name: Indie Pop Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 68th birthday to Ian Broudie of The Lightning Seeds on August 4th! 'Three Lions' or 'Pure'?

angles.name: Football Anthem King
angles.copy: Get ready to sing 'It's Coming Home' as we celebrate Ian Broudie's 68th birthday this Tuesday! What's your favourite Lightning Seeds song?

moments.title: Happy 29th to Yungblud
moments.blurb: Dominic Harrison, known professionally as Yungblud, the English rock musician, turns 29 on August 5th.

angles.name: Rock Star Turns 29
angles.copy: Happy 29th birthday to the one and only Yungblud on Wednesday! What's your favourite track from the Doncaster rocker?

angles.name: Gen Z Icon
angles.copy: Celebrating Yungblud's birthday this week! His energetic performances and anthems have resonated with a generation. What's your go-to Yungblud song?

moments.title: Happy 67th to Pat Smear
moments.blurb: Pat Smear, American guitarist known for his work with Germs, Nirvana, and Foo Fighters, turns 67 on August 5th.

angles.name: Punk Rock Royalty
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 67th birthday to the legendary Pat Smear on Wednesday! From The Germs to Nirvana and Foo Fighters, he's been part of rock history.

angles.name: Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Celebrate Pat Smear's birthday this week! A true rock chameleon, his guitar work has shaped some of the biggest sounds of the last few decades.

moments.title: Happy 68th to Bruce Dickinson
moments.blurb: Bruce Dickinson, the iconic lead singer of British heavy metal band Iron Maiden, turns 68 on August 7th.

angles.name: Metal Icon
angles.copy: Scream for me, UK! Bruce Dickinson, the legendary voice of Iron Maiden, turns 68 this Thursday. What's your favourite Maiden anthem?

angles.name: Air Raid Siren
angles.copy: Happy birthday to Bruce Dickinson! Beyond Iron Maiden, he's an airline pilot, author, and fencer. A true renaissance man turns 68!

moments.title: Happy 66th to Jacquie O'Sullivan
moments.blurb: Jacquie O'Sullivan, English singer and former member of the iconic 80s girl group Bananarama, turns 66 on August 7th.

angles.name: Bananarama Star
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 66th birthday to Jacquie O'Sullivan of Bananarama this Thursday! Get those 80s hits ready!

angles.name: 80s Pop Princess
angles.copy: Celebrate Jacquie O'Sullivan's birthday this week! Her time in Bananarama gave us some unforgettable pop anthems.

moments.title: Happy 65th to The Edge
moments.blurb: David Evans, known as The Edge, the influential guitarist, keyboardist, and backing vocalist of Irish rock band U2, turns 65 on August 8th.

angles.name: U2 Guitar Hero
angles.copy: Happy 65th birthday to the legendary The Edge from U2 this Friday! His distinctive sound has defined a generation of rock music.

angles.name: Iconic Sound
angles.copy: Celebrate The Edge's birthday! That unmistakable guitar tone is 65 this week. What's your favourite U2 track featuring his magic?

moments.title: Happy 79th to Ian Anderson
moments.blurb: Ian Anderson, Scottish musician, singer, and songwriter, best known as the frontman and flautist of the progressive rock band Jethro Tull, turns 79 on August 10th.

angles.name: Prog Rock Pioneer
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 79th birthday to the incredible Ian Anderson of Jethro Tull on Monday! Who else loves a bit of rock flute?

angles.name: Jethro Tull Legend
angles.copy: Celebrate Ian Anderson's birthday! His unique talent brought Jethro Tull to global fame. What's your favourite album or song?

moments.title: Happy 62nd to Neneh Cherry
moments.blurb: Neneh Cherry, Swedish singer-songwriter, rapper, and occasional DJ, known for hits like 'Buffalo Stance' and 'Manchild', turns 62 on August 10th.

angles.name: Genre-Bending Icon
angles.copy: Happy 62nd birthday to the brilliant Neneh Cherry on Monday! A true innovator in pop, hip hop, and dance music. What's your top Neneh Cherry track?

angles.name: Buffalo Stance Star
angles.copy: Celebrating Neneh Cherry's birthday! Her distinctive style and sound broke barriers. Throwback to her incredible influence!

moments.title: Happy 42nd to James Morrison
moments.blurb: James Morrison, the English singer-songwriter known for his soulful voice and hits like 'You Give Me Something', turns 42 on August 12th.

angles.name: Soulful Voice
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 42nd birthday to the amazing James Morrison this Wednesday! That voice just melts you. What's your favourite song?

angles.name: British Talent
angles.copy: Celebrate James Morrison's birthday! His heartfelt songs have captivated audiences worldwide. What's your go-to James Morrison tune?
